description: Attach a document (typed info) to a record BY REFERENCE — no file bytes, url just points at something hosted elsewhere. Required: entity ('lead'|'contact'|'account'|'campaign'), entity_id, title. Optional: doc_type (default 'note'), description (the analyzable text), source, url, amount, currency, status, occurred_at (ISO). To attach an actual FILE (get it stored + optionally AI-summarized), use upload_document instead.

entity.description: Record type the document is attached to: lead, contact, account or campaign

url.description: Link to where the document is hosted

name: add_document
